claims.claim_text: Additional officers arrived at approximately 1911 hours to render aid to Officer Webb.
Officers formulated a plan to approach the subject, and at approximately 1916 hours, the subject was disarmed, moved to the sidewalk, and handcuffed.
At approximately 1920 hours, paramedics from the Los Angeles County Fire Department arrived and determined the subject had no pulse or respiration.
The subject was pronounced deceased at approximately 1926 hours.

A subsequent search recovered two firearms from the subject's person: a Glock-style 9mm semi-automatic pistol with no serial number and a .40 caliber Glock semi-automatic pistol with a mounted flashlight.
